list.description: Choose who must approve each kind of request, and in what order. Types without a flow keep working: anyone with approval permission approves or rejects in one step (single-step approval).
list.scope: Every approval type that supports multi-step flows is listed here.
list.empty: No approval type supports multi-step flows yet.

mode.unset: Requests are approved or rejected in one step by anyone with approval permission.
mode.unsetCanUpdate: Requests are approved or rejected in one step by anyone with approval permission. Set up a multi-step flow when several people must approve in order.
mode.enabled: Every request goes through these steps in order; steps whose conditions don't match are skipped.
mode.disabled: The flow is disabled, so requests are approved in a single step. Re-enabling it keeps these settings.

edit.enabledHint: When disabled, this type goes back to single-step approval. The settings are kept.
edit.allowRepeatApprover: Allow the same person to approve two steps
edit.allowRepeatApproverHint: Off by default: people who decided an earlier step are excluded from later steps.

impact.inFlight_one: {{count}} request in progress keeps the steps it was submitted with; only new requests use these settings.
impact.inFlight_other: {{count}} requests in progress keep the steps they were submitted with; only new requests use these settings.
impact.disable: After disabling, new requests use single-step approval: anyone with approval permission approves or rejects.
impact.enable: After enabling, new requests go through these steps.

step.name: Step name
step.conditions: Conditions (all must match for this step to run)
step.noCondition: No conditions: every request goes through this step.
step.requiredCountHint_one: Any {{count}} reviewer approving passes this step; any rejection rejects the whole request.
step.requiredCountHint_other: Any {{count}} reviewers approving passes this step; any rejection rejects the whole request.
step.requiredAllHint: Everyone who is a reviewer when this step starts must approve; any rejection rejects the whole request.
step.lastStepPermission: The last step that runs (skipped steps excluded) only includes reviewers who also have "{{permissions}}": approving means performing the action on the requester's behalf.

assignee.inactive: This rule currently assigns no one
assignee.rejected: This reviewer is unavailable (it assigns no one or the target was deleted). Choose another reviewer.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: Preview which steps the current draft (including unsaved changes) runs and who reviews each.
preview.incomplete: Some steps are incomplete. Fill in the name, reviewers and conditions first.

outcome.userRegister: Create the account and send the activation email

summary.title: Flow summary
summary.previewHint: Marked using the sample request on the right: dashed steps are skipped, red ones do not have enough reviewers.

template.title: Start from a template
template.description: Pick the closest flow; you can change everything afterwards. Reviewers that need to be chosen are left blank.

manager.label: Requester's manager
manager.description: One step: the requester's direct manager approves.

managerThenRole.label: Manager, then a role
managerThenRole.description: Two steps: the direct manager first, then someone with a given role (for example, administrators).

role.label: Anyone with a role
role.description: One step: any holder of a given role can approve.

reviewThenApprove.label: Review, then approve
reviewThenApprove.description: Two steps: a named person reviews first, then someone with a given role approves.

blank.label: Start from scratch
blank.description: A blank step; set the reviewers, approvals and conditions yourself.

stats.title: How it is going (last {{days}} days)
stats.empty: No requests of this type recently.
stats.line: {{submitted}} submitted in the last {{days}} days, {{pending}} in progress

reset.title: Reset the flow
reset.description: This type goes back to single-step approval: anyone with approval permission approves or rejects new requests. The current steps are removed (recorded in the audit log); next time you start from a template.
reset.inFlight_one: {{count}} request in progress finishes with the steps it was submitted with.
reset.inFlight_other: {{count}} requests in progress finish with the steps they were submitted with.
